title: Interpretable machine learning for shoreline forecasting
summary: Genetic-programming symbolic regression optimized equations on 145 of 7,202 global coastal points, then evaluated on 7,057 unseen points using monthly 1994–2019 shoreline data; models identified region-specific wave, sea-level and freshwater drivers.

evidence.tested: Genetic-programming symbolic regression optimized equations on 145 of 7,202 global coastal points, then evaluated on 7,057 unseen points using monthly 1994–2019 shoreline data; models identified region-specific wave, sea-level and freshwater drivers. Large spatial holdout supports generalization; Sobol driver rankings are approximate because environmental inputs may be correlated. Retrospective data, not prospective field validation.
evidence.unknown: The study does not establish performance or consequences beyond the reported cohort, datasets, task or experimental setup.
